visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-bleed rotating image slideshow at the top of the page, with prev/next arrows and dot indicators
visualCharacteristics.description: 5 full-width Dynamic Media photo slides, no text, dot indicators and prev/next arrows | Full-bleed image-only slideshow at page top with dot indicators; no slide text

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide; cell 1 = slide image (picture, image link or bare Dynamic Media URL, rendered with its query string intact); cell 2 = optional text (heading, description, CTA), may be left empty
contentPattern.description: Interactive rotating component with navigation; slides carry no text, photo background belongs to the block

usage: Page-top hero slideshow of full-width photos, optionally with overlaid text per slide.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any full-width image slideshow. For a single static hero image use hero instead.
